items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: Dave Bell has that, I guess. Oh, is that right? He still has the horn. I'm sure he'd never get rid of it.

ctx.x: And John Skank. And at that time, he was living with Dave Bell, and Loughborough was...if he wasn't living with Dave Bell, they were always there at the apartment. Oh. So it was after the spring of 1947. I think that must have been almost fall of 1947, before he went up there for Malts, and then that other engagement at the Stuyvesant, and the ones up there at the Caravan, and all
